items.author: rusty.cubhub.social
items.context: Uh. Hmm. I have no memory of buying Yooka Re-Playlee and yet it's on my Steam Deck :blobcatgooglyshocked:​ Huh. Wonder if it's any good because the original was _not_.
items.text: Fun mystery. Your Steam account's purchase history shows when and how it landed in your library, often a bundle or a gift.

items.author: gamersonarant.bsky.social
items.context:
The gamer’s internal struggle… “I really don’t need to buy anymore games on sale. My backlog is ridiculous. Well…just a quick look at the sales won’t hurt right?” 😅
2 images, no description
items.text: A quick look at the sales is always how it starts 😅 Wishlisting a game helps: Steam notifies you when it drops, so you don't need to keep browsing.

items.author: aerialslayer.bsky.social
items.context: What game do you always recommend to people?
items.text: Stardew Valley for me. It's easy to pick up for people new to games, runs on almost any PC, and works for short or long sessions.

items.author: taliskan.me
items.context: Unexpectedly beat Like a Dragon Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii last night on stream. Wonderful game and my entry into the Yakuza games. Monday we start Yakuza 0, and I'm really looking forward to it.
items.text: Great pick to start the series. Yakuza 0 is a prequel, so you're not missing anything by starting there. Have fun!
